act_type.rationale: The text makes a sustained series of truth claims: what LLMs are, what synthesis means in this context, what the architectural spine of the ecosystem is. No directive, commissive, expressive, or declarative force is primary. Epistemic hedges ('not a finished theory,' 'open to falsification') reinforce the assertive frame rather than undermining it.

transmission.rationale: The text is a definitional framing document — past-to-future in orientation, preserved as a record of what the project is and why. Not broadcast to a general public (no address to a broad audience), not a leak (no restricted or charged unofficial status). It reads as institutional record-setting.

resonance.surface: Constructive integration of semantic and digital poles; synthesis framed as productive joining, not resolution of conflict

authority.source: The internal logic of the project model and the observed operational nature of LLMs — real and operative, but not inscribed in any formal institution or peer community
authority.rationale: No sovereign institution backs these claims. No tribal community is invoked. The authority flows from the coherence of the model itself and from what LLMs demonstrably do — acknowledged within the project but absent from any official record outside it.

utility.rationale: Primary function is meaning-making: explaining the semantic-digital duality, defining synthesis, and situating logos within the ecosystem. Secondary is instruction: the framing implicitly orients practitioners on how to work within and extend the system.

social_field.rationale: Moderately high grid: explicit definitional constraints (logos, synthesis, semantic/digital split, falsifiability norm) impose a conceptual structure on how work proceeds, though the open-revision stance softens rigidity. Moderate group: a bounded project identity exists ('the project,' 'the ecosystem') but no strong communal membership signal. The combination places it in the hierarchical quadrant — structured roles and rules without deep in-group solidarity.

conflict.rationale: Within a hierarchical institution where authority is occult, an assertive architectural claim is being archived — the schema is actively shaping how legitimacy must be performed, with surface harmony absent any underlying resonance, accumulating the conditions for friction as the framework encounters undisclosed power structures.

raw_text: The system goal is to develop semantics for working with conflict data in order to produce or predict beneficial outcomes from constructed functional models. LLMs are both semantic and digital. The semantic side uses language to form meaning hypotheses and inference while the digital side performs the structured work and returns that work as language. The semantic side can be understood as logos: the language of meaning analogy memory and communication. The project favors synthesis but not as an abstract philosophical endpoint. Here synthesis means the constructive joining of semantic meaning and digital structure in service of beneficial outcomes. This is not presented as a finished theory. It is a working model that survives revision improves under pressure and remains open to falsification while continuing to generate useful structure. The duality between semantic and digital layers is not merely decorative. It is the architectural spine of the ecosystem.
